title: REQ · Duration field is sent to the backend when creating a Round
summary: A Create round control posts the duration in hours to POST /api/v1/admin/rounds
description: Add a createRound client call and a Create round button in AdminApp that posts {world_id, duration: `${durationHours}h`} with the bearer token, then reloads the current round id. Backend admin Create parses duration with time.ParseDuration.
acceptance_criteria: Given Duration is 12, when Create round is clicked, then a POST to /api/v1/admin/rounds is sent with JSON body world_id the-boys-room and duration 12h and a Bearer header.
Given the create call returns 401, when it completes, then AdminApp returns to the token gate; other failures show the error message.

preserve: Open round and Close round buttons
